inhibits-across-clusters.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: owned
  group_by:
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
- name: owned
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/owned
    send_resolved: true
inhibit_rules:
- source_matchers:
  - role="cause"
  target_matchers:
  - role="effect"
  equal: []

also-targets-independent-observer.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: owned
  group_by:
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
- name: owned
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/owned
    send_resolved: true
inhibit_rules:
- source_matchers:
  - role="cause"
  target_matchers:
  - role=~"effect|observer"
  equal:
  - cluster

disables-required-recovery-webhook.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: owned
  group_by:
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
- name: owned
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/owned
    send_resolved: false
inhibit_rules:
- source_matchers:
  - role="cause"
  target_matchers:
  - role="effect"
  equal:
  - cluster
